valid_window.definition: FC_THRUST frames count toward the over-thrust abort only while ALL of: (1) airborne latch set (h_est > 1 m once after liftoff; the latch never clears); (2) h_est > 1 m; (3) ECU in RUN (engine lit, the over-thrust check has no meaning with the MV closed); (4) no drogue load: before the drogue deploys, or after the release confirmed by the release command plus the load-cell or drop-out indication; (5) no tether load (flight C rule below); (6) before touchdown (leg switch or the touchdown logic). A frame outside the window resets the consecutive count. Stale accelerometer data (> 50 ms) flag only, never abort (lead rule).
valid_window.sim6: amendment F: fc_air (h_est > 1 m latch) and h_est > 1 m and lit and not drogue and not td_done; the drogue state is the sim's attachment state (A1: deployed at apogee, released when the relight thrust exceeds half the floor)
valid_window.covers: the A1 ascent cases from 500 N (no drogue load before deployment), the A1 landing burn after the release, every B1 phase; the A1 relight transient while the drogue still loads the vehicle is outside the window: there the Pc-valid detectors and PINTLE_FAULT act alone
valid_window.tags: REQ wording proposed by GNC for the lead (review RG-18); sim6 amendment F implements it

tether_rule_flight_C.proposal: flight C (tethered): the tether load enters the force balance (F_acc = m_hat f_z + D_model + T_meas along the body axis) when a tether load cell feeds the flight computer, and its uncertainty enters the RG-16 budget; without a load cell, FC_THRUST is outside its valid window whenever the tether can be taut, and flight C needs a valid Pc (over-pressure abort) and the PINTLE_FAULT path as GO conditions
tether_rule_flight_C.why: a taut tether pulling down by T makes F_acc under-read the thrust by T: a stuck pintle can be masked by the tether
tether_rule_flight_C.tags: PROPOSAL GNC; tether hardware, load-cell range and data path TO-DEFINE (Mechanical, Electronics)
